capacity_identity.industry_queue_order: rebound_from_post_gap_low_over_l descending, then symbol and gap_id
capacity_identity.purpose: precommitted economic admission: diversify simultaneous supply shocks across industries, then prefer the strongest verified demand recovery within each industry
capacity_identity.raw_signal_role_after_outcome_open: morphology and rejection audit only; raw outcomes may not compete with the primary result

economic_hypothesis: A gap older than 14 sessions can become economically fresh again when a renewed sell wave has just printed the stock's 20-session low and demand then completes the already-frozen V13 prior-high reversal. The recent low resets seller urgency without changing the frozen trigger, cost zone, or demand-quality gates.

frozen_signal_rule.action_coordinate_policy: require an action-free exact-CY033 union of the gap-to-signal path and signal-inclusive trailing-20 window; otherwise fail closed, including unknown corporate_action_blocking
frozen_signal_rule.amount_gate: signal raw amount <= 2.0 * median raw amount over exactly 20 completed trading sessions strictly before signal
frozen_signal_rule.fixed_parent_identity: frozen V13 PRIOR_HIGH_REVERSAL gap_id and signal_time from development/signals.parquet; never read the sibling entry artifact and never search a later trigger
frozen_signal_rule.liquidity_and_state_gate: signal hard_valid, tradable, traded, non-ST; prior 20 completed daily rows have known trade status and, when traded, known positive OHLC/down-limit, and contain <=1 raw one-price limit-down
frozen_signal_rule.not_locked_gate: signal raw close < registered up_limit_price - 0.006 CNY
frozen_signal_rule.only_signal_morphology_change_from_v27: replace F14 by gap_age<=14 OR (15<=gap_age<=30 AND 1<=days_since_low20<=3)
frozen_signal_rule.primary_outcome_rule: the morphology gate plus the separately preregistered CAP25 industry-diversified, rebound-ranked economic admission
frozen_signal_rule.rebound_gate: uniform raw-CY033 max_depth-current_depth >= 0.05 of frozen L
frozen_signal_rule.uniform_feature_recomputation: At the fixed parent signal only, recompute gap_age, max/current depth, most-recent minimum raw-cent-tick low in the signal-inclusive trailing 20, recovery using that exact row raw low, and all V13 thresholds. Parent feature columns are audit comparators, not gates.
frozen_signal_rule.required_lineage: every accessed CY033 row hard_valid with all component snapshot IDs and available_at<=row.decision_at<=frozen signal_time
